content.short: Defi App is a mobile-first platform for swaps, perpetuals and yield across EVM chains.
content.description: Defi App brings swapping, perpetuals and yield into a single mobile interface spanning EVM networks and Hyperliquid. Mobile-first DeFi has been attempted repeatedly and usually founders on key management, which is the problem any such product has to solve before the trading features matter.
content.meta: Swaps, perpetuals and yield across EVM chains and Hyperliquid from a single mobile app.
